name: ddalcu/mlx-serve
title: MLX-Serve v26.11.4 serves Thinking Machines' Inkling 2 Mini on M1-M6 Macs with draft-tree speculative decoding, 10-13% faster decode
summary: The Apple Silicon server now runs Inkling 2 Mini from its released checkpoint with image input and batched drafting, speeds DeepSeek-V4.1 decode about 11% on M5, extends Thunderbolt tensor parallel past two Macs, and resumes long sliding-window sessions without re-reading context (Gemma 4 26B at 80K: 20 s to 2 s first token).

appearances.summary: A pre-release of MLX-Serve reads model experts from SSD, which the poster says lets GLM-5.3-Flash run on a 128 GB Mac with its full 1M-token context at about 35 tokens per second, and can split larger models across two Macs over Thunderbolt 5.
